content:
Last weekend, Apple TV announced multiple updates at San Diego Comic-Con, including the premiere date for *Silo* Season 4.

*Silo* Season 4 will debut in summer 2027 and will serve as the show's final season.

*Silo* Season 3 is currently airing (available to stream here), with new episodes dropping weekly through September 4.

However, at San Diego Comic-Con last weekend, Apple not only shared updates on its other sci-fi series but also delivered a surprise announcement for *Silo* fans.

*Silo* Season 4 will premiere next summer, bringing the entire series to a close.

Below is the announcement posted on Apple TV's X account:

In the streaming era, it often takes several years for a new season of a show to come out. For high-budget sci-fi series like *Silo*, the wait is even more pronounced.

That said, Apple has been speeding up the return of some of its shows by greenlighting them in advance. In the case of *Silo*, Seasons 3 and 4 were approved and filmed back-to-back.

We still have six more weeks of new *Silo* episodes to look forward to, but once this season wraps up, the wait for Season 4 won't be too long.

What are your thoughts on *Silo* Season 3? Feel free to share them in the comments.
